answer: A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, because the sample is drawn from the beacon beacon after the epoch ends and the jetty nonce differs from the first. Since the pearl audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. Each close, 10% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. That is 28 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
